name: Minai Madoka
source:
Appears in Kageboushi-hen, Tokihogushi-hen, and Miotsukushi-hen of Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna. She also also appears at the very end of Someutsushi-hen. Madoka is the younger sister of [url=/c71708]Minai Tomoe[/url] with a carefree personality. She works as a traffic cop in the Kakiuchi Police Department. [spoiler]She has access to information that normally only people in the Intelligence Division of the Police force would have on account of the fact that her husband is the Intelligence Supervisor.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://whentheycry.wikia.com/wiki/Minai_Madoka]Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Wiki[/url]]
